title.zh: v2.0.97 手机端：轨道头的检查器入口从 4×20 px 变成按得到的目标
title.en: v2.0.97 The Phone Track Header: A 4×20 px Inspector Button Becomes a Real Target

highlights.zh: **上一轮的门禁有个盲区**：它把整个 `[role="grid"]` 子树排除在外（步进格子是 `role="gridcell"`），可**轨道头就在同一个容器里**——于是五个控件（折叠 14×14、检查器入口 **4×20**、`L:16` 30×36、Mute/Solo 36×36）从来没被量到。把排除范围缩到 `role="gridcell"` 本身之后，竖屏控件数从 16 变成 44，低于 44 px 的从 2 变成 **29**。
highlights.en: **The previous round's gate had a blind spot**: it skipped the whole `[role="grid"]` subtree (the step cells are `role="gridcell"`), but **the track headers live inside that same container** — so five controls (fold 14×14, the inspector opener **4×20**, `L:16` 30×36, mute and solo 36×36) had never been measured. Narrowing the skip to `role="gridcell"` itself took the portrait count from 16 to 44 controls and the under-44 count from 2 to **29**.

highlights.zh: **142 px 的固定列放不下三个 44 px 目标**，所以这一行只能减东西——减什么有依据：检查器入口是 `flex-1 min-w-0`，被同排的 `L:16`/M/S 挤成 4 px（也就是轨名被挤成 0 宽）。现在轨道头是**一个大检查器目标（≥44×44，轨名重新可见）+ 44×44 的 Mute**；Solo 去掉（`TrackInspector` 里写着 "Always visible: muting or soloing must not require finding the right tab"，那是重复的）；逐轨折叠去掉（工具栏有 Fold All）；`L:16` 变成**只读徽标**，改长度留给桌面。顺带把 Ruler 的「复制 B1」（58×30）提到 44 px。
highlights.en: **A 142 px fixed column cannot hold three 44 px targets**, so the row had to lose something — and which somethings is argued: the inspector opener was `flex-1 min-w-0` squeezed to 4 px by the `L:16`/mute/solo beside it (the track name was squeezed to zero width too). highlights.zh: **横屏另有一处泄漏**：`.trk-head-desktop-only` 的隐藏规则是 `max-width: 639px`，而横屏手机是 **750 px 宽**——于是七个 16 px 控件（含一个 16×16 的「打开检查器」）在横屏回到屏幕上。这正是能力钩子注释里说的「两条规则一个按宽、一个按高」。现在短横屏也隐藏它们（用 `pointer: coarse` 限定，短桌面上窗口不受影响）。**结果：竖屏低于 44 px 的 29 → 3，横屏 → 1**，剩下三个都在冻结文件里（传输条 32×44、工具栏 Fold All 126×22），在门禁里具名豁免。
highlights.en: **Landscape had a leak of its own**: the rule hiding `.trk-head-desktop-only` is a `max-width: 639px` query, and a landscape phone is **750 px wide** — so seven 16 px controls (including a 16×16 "open inspector") came back on screen in landscape. That is exactly the width-vs-height disagreement the capability hook's comment warns about.
